status: local prospective protocol, not external preregistration
order: seeded first permutation; reverse for second; common across conditions within repetition
participants: fresh fork-none agents; no model or reasoning override
tool_rule: one input-loading read of assigned file; afterwards no tools; root supplies only outputs of actually selected queries
primary_endpoint: number of Bayes-optimal initial commands under exact finite public-prior dynamic programming; all exact ties accepted
secondary_endpoints: strict unnecessary continuation: chosen query with Q greater than best feasible immediate terminal loss
paid query fees and total queries
conditional terminal action excess loss over best feasible terminal action at that reached state
realized terminal loss plus paid fees, descriptive only
invalid or missing commands and word-cap violations
diagnostic: sum of nonnegative Bellman gaps Q(chosen)-V at visited public-belief states; trajectory-local, not unobserved full-policy ex ante regret
oracle_information: only public model, past selected query results, spent cash/time and permissions; never private world when evaluating commands
posterior: exact conditioning on deterministic query results; retain all consistent prior-positive worlds
query_quality: evaluate before its outcome, including multi-step continuation; unchanged terminal action on a realized branch is not by itself wasted inquiry
invalid_handling: missing, unknown, duplicate, infeasible, repeated, or malformed command forces specified feasible fallback at no additional request charge, closes episode, and is counted invalid
inference_limits: selected synthetic families directly relevant to method
actual hidden reasoning and sampling seeds uncontrolled
endogenous visited histories differ across treatments
available variable/query grammar supplied; no unbounded concept discovery tested
stop_rule: complete the six planned contexts without adding trials based on outcomes; preserve every result and report any post-freeze defect separately
